buildKind: React production profiling renderer; test-only main/App transforms
method: Separate profiling builds, never regular production timing. Isolated Chromium/CDP browser contexts, synthetic localStorage/IndexedDB, cloud env disabled and HTTPS blocked. Alternating baseline/current side order each sample; same deterministic selected-scale saved history and a uniquely identified resumed draft. Startup/setup excluded. React Profiler wraps App below StoreProvider, so durations include the App subtree, while the App entry counter counts App invocations including any uncommitted render attempts. Minute text is local editor input; 1H SOT publishes a draft Store update. Input dispatch to two requestAnimationFrames, primary setItem/read-back and IndexedDB mirror transaction completion are distinct measurements. Autosave retains the existing 450ms debounce. Long-task entries are observed only for interaction windows. Synthetic DOM input dispatch excludes physical keyboard latency. No real user profile, real DB or physical Safari/PWA.

excludedBrowserFixture.reason: Unchanged 13.35 MB JSON exceeds native Chromium localStorage; actual QuotaExceededError and previous-value preservation recorded separately. No quota override or fake primary storage.
